title: Quest. 147. How far is Tradition and mens Words and Ministry to be used or trusted in, in the exercise of faith?

segments.text: Answ. 1. THe Churches and Ministers received the Gospel in Scripture from the Apostles, and the Creed as the summary of faith: And they delivered it down to others, and they to us:
2. The Ministers by Office are the Instructers of the people in the meaning of it. And the keepers of the Scriptures, as Lawyers are of the Laws of the Land.
